comparison.objective: Draw down a manikin eyelid, dispense exactly one eye drop into the pocket, and put the bottle away; candidate tunes a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Eye-drop task tests delicate bimanual tissue positioning, squeeze-force dosing, noncontact aiming, and fluid delivery; candidate tests rigid tool insertion, rotary adjustment, locking, and dynamic cycle evaluation.
comparison.success_condition: Eye task requires one 40 µL drop with lid draw ≥3 mm, no nozzle/hand contamination contact, bounded head force, and bottle return; candidate requires safe two-cycle carriage behavior and lock retention.
comparison.reason: Dosing and delicate noncontact care are unrelated to damper commissioning. Missing rubric details: fluid behavior is a simplified straight-fall model, explicitly stated.
